data.situation: The following week, Lin returned to the library print room with the canteen application still inside her notebook. She had not decided about the job. For now, she and Jo had a handout to prepare for their class. Their tutor had asked for no more than two printed pages, with a short list of references at the end. Lin put the instructions beside the printer and opened their file. The first copy came out as three pages. The title stood alone on the first page, while the discussion and references filled the next two. “We need to comply with the page requirement,” Lin said. Jo moved the title above the opening paragraph, leaving the reference list in place. They kept the text large enough to read. The revised file had two pages and still included every reference. At the long counter, Jo put page two underneath page one and checked the numbers at the bottom. A red stapler sat beside a box of paper clips. Lin asked the assistant, “May I borrow the stapler?” She fastened the two pages together at the top left corner. Jo opened the copy once more and checked that the second page was not upside down. They checked this copy before printing the rest. Two pages, readable text, and the references at the end: it was within the limit. Soon a small stack lay beside the door, ready to carry upstairs. Lin closed the notebook with the application still inside. On the top handout, the title read “Questions about cognition”. Tomorrow, the class would have something more interesting to discuss than a missing page.
data.easySummary: The first handout has three pages, but the limit is two. Lin and Jo move the title onto the first page of the discussion and keep the references. They comply with the page requirement, put the pages in order, and borrow a stapler.
data.easySummaryZh: 第一份讲义有三页，要求最多两页。林和乔把标题移到讨论内容的第一页，保留参考资料。她们满足页数要求，排好页序，再借订书机装订。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The instructions allow no more than two pages. Your file has three. Tell Jo why you need to change it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 要求不超过两页，文件现在有三页。告诉乔为什么要调整。
acceptableAnswers: We need to comply with the page requirement. The limit is two pages.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: State the maximum number, not a minimum.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说明是最多两页，不是至少两页。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Two loose pages are in the right order. Ask the assistant for the tool that fastens them together.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 两张散页已按顺序排好。向工作人员借能把它们订起来的工具。
acceptableAnswers: May I borrow the stapler to fasten these two pages?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the tool and the pages you want to fasten.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说出工具和准备装订的纸页。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The title has moved above the opening paragraph. The text and references are still there, and the file now has two pages. Explain why it can be printed.

acceptableAnswers: It is within the limit of two pages, and it complies with the page requirement. The references are still included.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Keep the required references when explaining the change.

transferPrompt.cue: An exhibition allows a leaflet of no more than one page. Your draft has a separate title page and one page of information. Explain how to follow the requirement without removing the opening times. You will not need to fasten several pages together.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 展览要求传单不超过一页。初稿有独立标题页和一页信息。说明怎样在保留开放时间的情况下符合要求；最终不需把多页订在一起。
acceptableAnswers: We should move the title above the information to comply with the page requirement. The limit is one page, so the opening times must stay on that page.
transferPrompt.feedback: Use the one-page requirement; do not repeat the two-page classroom limit.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 新情况的上限是一页，不能套用课堂的两页。
